import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, t;
    static char[][] A;
    static char[][] B;
    static boolean[][][][][] _dp;
    static boolean[][][][] dp;
    static int[][] tim;
    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> G;
    static int[][] C;
    static int[] E;
    static int[] H;
    static int[][] pN;
    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> dinicG;
    static int dinicN;

    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        dinicG.get(u).add(new Edge(v, dinicG.get(v).size(), cap));
        dinicG.get(v).add(new Edge(u, dinicG.get(u).size() - 1, 0));
    }

    static boolean dinicBFS(int s, int t, int[] level) {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        level[s] = 0;
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : dinicG.get(v)) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] < 0) {
                    level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.add(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[t] >= 0;
    }

    static int dinicDFS(int v, int t, int f, int[] level, int[] iter) {
        if (v == t) return f;
        for (; iter[v] < dinicG.get(v).size(); iter[v]++) {
            Edge e = dinicG.get(v).get(iter[v]);
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[v] < level[e.to]) {
                int d = dinicDFS(e.to, t, Math.min(f, e.cap), level, iter);
                if (d > 0) {
                    e.cap -= d;
                    dinicG.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += d;
                    return d;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        int flow = 0;
        int[] level = new int[dinicN];
        int[] iter = new int[dinicN];
        while (dinicBFS(s, t, level)) {
            Arrays.fill(iter, 0);
            int f;
            while ((f = dinicDFS(s, t, 1000000000, level, iter)) > 0) {
                flow += f;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static void setdp(int tt, int x, int y, int x0, int y0) {
        if (t >= 70) return;
        if (x < 0 || x >= n || y < 0 || y >= n) return;
        if (A[x][y] < '0' || A[x][y] > '9') return;
        if (tt > t + 1) return;
        if (_dp[tt][x][y][x0][y0]) return;
        if (tt > tim[x][y] && tim[x][y] != 0) return;
        if (tt == tim[x][y] && tim[x][y] != 0 && (B[x][y] > '9' || B[x][y] <= '0')) return;
        _dp[tt][x][y][x0][y0] = true;

        if (tt < tim[x][y]) {
            setdp(tt + 1, x, y, x0, y0);
            setdp(tt + 1, x + 1, y, x0, y0);
            setdp(tt + 1, x - 1, y, x0, y0);
            setdp(tt + 1, x, y + 1, x0, y0);
            setdp(tt + 1, x, y - 1, x0, y0);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        A = new char[n][n];
        B = new char[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                A[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                B[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        tim = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(tim[i], -1);
        }

        Deque<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (A[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    tim[i][j] = 0;
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }

        int[] di = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
        int[] dj = {0, -1, 0, 1};

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.pollFirst();
            if (tim[p[0]][p[1]] >= t) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int ni = p[0] + di[d];
                int nj = p[1] + dj[d];
                if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n &&
                    A[ni][nj] >= '0' && A[ni][nj] <= '9' && tim[ni][nj] == -1) {
                    tim[ni][nj] = tim[p[0]][p[1]] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (tim[i][j] == -1) tim[i][j] = t;
            }
        }

        _dp = new boolean[70][n][n][n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (A[i][j] >= '0' && A[i][j] <= '9') {
                    setdp(0, i, j, i, j);
                }
            }
        }

        dp = new boolean[n][n][n][n];
        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; i1++) {
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++) {
                for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++) {
                    for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++) {
                        for (int nt = 0; nt <= t; nt++) {
                            dp[i1][j1][i2][j2] |= _dp[nt][i1][j1][i2][j2];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        G = new ArrayList<>();
        G.add(new ArrayList<>()); // node 0 (sink)
        E = new int[210];
        H = new int[210];
        C = new int[210][210];
        pN = new int[n][n];

        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; i1++) {
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++) {
                if (A[i1][j1] > '0' && A[i1][j1] <= '9') {
                    int k = G.size();
                    G.add(new ArrayList<>());
                    E[k] = A[i1][j1] - '0';
                    for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++) {
                        for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++) {
                            if (B[i2][j2] > '0' && B[i2][j2] <= '9' && dp[i2][j2][i1][j1]) {
                                int _k;
                                if (pN[i2][j2] == 0) {
                                    _k = G.size();
                                    G.add(new ArrayList<>());
                                    pN[i2][j2] = _k;
                                } else {
                                    _k = pN[i2][j2];
                                }
                                G.get(k).add(_k);
                                G.get(_k).add(k);
                                C[k][_k] = 10000;
                                C[_k][k] = 0;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++) {
            for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++) {
                if (B[i2][j2] > '0' && B[i2][j2] <= '9' && pN[i2][j2] > 0) {
                    int _k = pN[i2][j2];
                    G.get(_k).add(0);
                    C[_k][0] = B[i2][j2] - '0';
                    C[0][_k] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        dinicN = G.size() + 1;
        dinicG = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < dinicN; i++) {
            dinicG.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        int S = G.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < G.size(); i++) {
            for (int j : G.get(i)) {
                if (C[i][j] > 0) {
                    addEdge(i, j, C[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < G.size(); i++) {
            if (E[i] > 0) {
                addEdge(S, i, E[i]);
            }
        }
        int flow = maxFlow(S, 0);
        System.out.println(flow);
    }
}
